text: The 'Nanbowan' (楠波湾) title sponsor of Liaoning Tieren is Liaoning Xinglin Nanbowan Plastic Surgery Hospital Group Co., Ltd. (辽宁杏林楠波湾整形外科医院集团有限公司), the Xinglin (杏林) medical group's Nanbowan plastic-surgery hospital in Shenyang. The club and the Xinglin group's hospital company signed the naming-rights deal on 15 December 2025.
short: Nanbowan (楠波湾) is the Xinglin medical group's plastic-surgery hospital brand.

source.name: Tencent News (九五体育sport95): 三大行业，成为中超球队胸前广告的赞助商 (The three industries sponsoring CSL clubs' shirt fronts)
source.quote: 杏林楠波湾是隶属于杏林集团的辽宁楠波湾整形外科医院
source.note: Translation: 'Xinglin Nanbowan is the Liaoning Nanbowan plastic-surgery hospital belonging to the Xinglin Group.'

additionalSources.name: Sohu (巴画侃宠物): 球衣印上楠波湾！辽宁铁人足球俱乐部与杏林国际楠波湾正式签约，达成冠名赞助合作
additionalSources.quote: 辽宁铁人足球俱乐部与杏林国际楠波湾正式牵手，达成了冠名赞助合作
additionalSources.note: Translation: 'Liaoning Tieren FC and Xinglin International Nanbowan formally joined hands, reaching a naming-sponsorship deal' — the 15 December 2025 signing ceremony in Shenyang, with Liaoning government officials present.
